Hi, I'm Hassane Ghanmi

Senior Frontend Engineer specializing in Angular, TypeScript, and modern frontend architecture. I build scalable, high-performance web applications — and I care about the craft.

View Projects Get in Touch
About

A builder at heart

I'm a Senior Frontend Engineer with over 8 years of experience building complex web applications for banking, insurance, and industrial platforms.

My core expertise is Angular — from architecture and state management to performance optimization and micro-frontends. I also have a strong foundation in vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS.

I'm currently building MyFiddle, a live web development playground similar to CodePen, with Angular on the frontend and a Java Spring Boot backend.

I'm based in Lisbon, Portugal, fluent in English and French, and available for remote or hybrid opportunities across Europe.
